matched_comparison: four classifiers x two representations; 5-fold stratified CV; identical model settings within each classifier across 74/10 feature representations

shap.sampling: without replacement from held-out test set
shap.model: ExtraTreesClassifier with matched 200-tree settings for both representations

preprocessing: all preprocessing and feature selection fitted only within training folds/pipelines
test_set: original 20% stratified held-out test set is used only for final evaluation
notes: Group-isolated held-out evaluation reported for all four classifiers; grouped CV is reported for Extra Trees and HistGradientBoosting only.
Grouped SHAP table is a descriptive sum of encoded-column mean absolute SHAP values, not a coalition-based grouped Shapley value.
execution_note: The matched comparison and reviewer supplementary analyses were generated from the included dataset with reviewer_supplementary.py. Paired SHAP results were generated with the included core script and SHAP 0.50.0. The main CLI entry point is provided for independent regeneration in Colab; generated CSVs and figures are included for direct comparison.
grouped_cv_scope: Five-fold grouped CV for ExtraTrees and HistGradientBoosting only; group-isolated held-out metrics are provided for all four classifiers.
